Container.Name: Unraid-Journal
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted single-user journal with filesystem storage, Markdown entries, attachments, search, and import/export.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port used directly or as the Nginx Proxy Manager target. Container port 8080 remains unchanged.

Config.Name: Journal Data
Config.Description: Persistent journal entries, attachments, settings, and search index.

Config.Name: Maximum Import Upload
Config.Description: Maximum uploaded import size in bytes.

Config.Name: Maximum Extracted Import
Config.Description: Maximum total extracted import size in bytes.

Config.Name: Maximum Import File
Config.Description: Maximum size of one extracted import file in bytes.

Config.Name: Maximum Import Files
Config.Description: Maximum number of files in one import.

Config.Name: Immich API URL
Config.Description: Optional Immich API base URL, for example http://immich:2283/api. Leave URL and key empty to disable the integration.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Optional Immich API key with album.read, asset.read, asset.view, and asset.download permissions.

Config.Name: Maximum Immich Image
Config.Description: Maximum imported Immich image size in bytes before preview fallback.
